description: A jewelled imperial crown with a red stone sits on a black velvet cushion, lit by a tall candle at its right. Behind it a black cloth with embroidered eagle motifs drapes over a shape, and to the left and right dark-robed, veiled figures stand with bowed heads. The background is a gilded Orthodox iconostasis with painted icons and more candles, all in a dim, smoky interior. No text, border or frame is visible; the painting runs edge to edge.
